title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good

claims.claim: The New York Times Cooking sitesi ve uygulaması 2025 yılında 514 milyon kez ziyaret edildi.

evidence.quote: NYT executive communications director Jordan Cohen said the site and app were visited 514 million times in 2025
The Times doesn't share Cooking's subscriber numbers, but NYT executive communications director Jordan Cohen said the site and app were visited 514 million times in 2025

claims.claim: The New York Times Cooking YouTube kanalının 1,4 milyondan fazla abonesi bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: its YouTube channel has over 1.4 million subscribers.

The Times doesn't share Cooking's subscriber numbers, but NYT executive communications director Jordan Cohen said the site and app were visited 514 million times in 2025, and its YouTube channel has over 1.4 million subscribers.

claims.claim: The New York Times, iOS'e özel bir beta sürümünde abonelerin tarifleri değiştirmesine olanak tanıyan bir yapay zeka özelliği kullanmaya başladı.

evidence.quote: In an iOS-only beta, the Times is now using AI to allow subscribers to modify recipes.

claims.claim: Yapay zeka tarifi özelleştirme duyurusu makalesinin altında dört gün boyunca neredeyse tamamen öfkeli 172 yorum yapıldıktan sonra yorum yapma özelliği kapatıldı.

evidence.quote: After four days and 172 almost exclusively angry comments, commenting for the story was turned off.

claims.claim: The New York Times Cooking ekibi 60 editör, yazar, video gazeteci ve diğer çalışanlardan oluşmaktadır.

evidence.quote: When I ask what this means for the jobs of 60 editors, writers, video journalists, and other employees—the team that creates the recipes people use and curates the vibe readers relate to—Velasquez stresses

When I ask what this means for the jobs of 60 editors, writers, video journalists, and other employees—the team that creates the recipes people use and curates the vibe readers relate to—Velasquez stresses that NYT Cooking has been "hiring more than ever"

claims.claim: Camilla Velasquez, NYT Cooking'in daha önce hiç olmadığı kadar çok işe alım yaptığını ve daha az tarif yayınlama niyetlerinin sıfır olduğunu belirtmiştir.

evidence.quote: Velasquez stresses that NYT Cooking has been "hiring more than ever" and that it has "zero intention of publishing fewer recipes."

claims.claim: Yazar, Alison Roman'ın 6.000'den fazla oylamaya sahip beş yıldızlı tavuk ve mantı tarifini test ederek yapay zeka aracını denemiştir.

evidence.quote: I started testing it out by making chicken and dumplings using a five-star Alison Roman recipe with more than 6,000 ratings.
